road.backdrop.far.brief: Far wooded hills along the river valley, two low ridges, the farther one paler, their tops broken by tree crowns. Few tones and little detail: these are miles off. Tiles left to right; transparent above the hill line.

road.backdrop.highbank_far.brief: Highbank seen from miles down the river: a flat-topped bluff with a few rows of roofs on it, and the Wayline Tower rising over the town more than three times its height, a beacon mast and lantern at the very top (the beacon anchor). Silhouette-level detail only: no windows, no doors. The bluff runs off the bottom edge.
road.backdrop.highbank_far.notes: drawn at 0.82x growing to 1x as the party nears the rise, hazed by the scene (0.5 down to 0.3); the coded beacon glint sits on anchors.beacon

road.backdrop.mid.brief: The wooded river trail: weeping willows with long hanging strands, their trunks down to the trail, flood debris caught in them (a snapped branch in a fork, driftwood at a root, a tangle of reeds). Gaps between the trees show the river and hills behind. Tiles left to right.
road.backdrop.mid.notes: parallax 0.45, hazed 0.1; fades out near the rise (the trees open)

road.backdrop.near.brief: Near foliage in front of the trail: dark ferns and reeds with seed heads, close to the camera, darkest of all the layers. Nothing above row 12. Tiles left to right; transparent above the plants.
road.backdrop.near.notes: parallax 1.35, drawn in front of the party

road.backdrop.river.brief: The river glimpsed between the willows: a band of slow brown-green water still high from the flood, pale streaks of current and a few glints of morning sky, a thin dark far bank along its top. Tiles left to right.
road.backdrop.river.notes: parallax 0.3; the scene lowers it 18 px and fades it out over the first half of the trail (the river dropping back)

road.backdrop.sky.brief: The dawn sky over the river valley the morning after the storm: cool slate blue at the top, warming through pale grey and rose to gold at the horizon (row 140), a few torn cloud bands lit gold underneath. Sky only, no ground, no sun disc. It does not scroll.
road.backdrop.sky.notes: parallax 0; everything below row 150 is covered by the trail

road.backdrop.vista.brief: The rise at first light: the willows open on both sides and Highbank lies below on its bluff, rows of roofs and chimneys, and over all of it the Wayline Tower, a tall river-stone tower with a beacon mast and lantern at the top (the beacon anchor). Grassy ground in the near left where the two stand (the party anchor is the leader's feet). Street lamps at the lamp anchors (paint them unlit: the game lights them and puts them out one by one) and chimney tops at the chimney anchors (the game draws the smoke).
road.backdrop.vista.notes: held view at the rise; coded effects: lamps going out one by one, chimney smoke, the beacon glint

road.ground.path.brief: The trail seen from the side: a grass verge at the back, a band of churned mud (rows 4 to 21) with cart ruts and rain puddles holding the sky, then a grassy slope down to the bottom. The party's feet stand on row 10. Tiles left to right.
road.ground.path.notes: parallax 1 (moves with the party and the props)

road.prop.ferry_sign.brief: A washed-out ferry sign by the trail: a leaning post with a plank sign, a boat painted on it (a picture, no letters), a flood line staining its lower half and a corner broken off. Mud at the foot.
road.prop.ferry_sign.notes: on the trail at x 430 (the bluff beat: the roads wash out every spring)

road.prop.lost_parcel.brief: A lost parcel half sunk in the mud at the trail's edge: a paper-wrapped box tipped on its corner, its twine dark with river water, the bottom third under mud with a wet sheen.
road.prop.lost_parcel.notes: on the trail at x 2016 (the parcel beat, a camera hold)

road.prop.waymark.brief: A Wayline waymark post: a squared timber post with a brass cap, a carved arrow pointing up the trail (right), a teal courier band, and an arm holding an unlit trail lantern.
road.prop.waymark.notes: on the trail at x 1236 (the Tower beat)

story.backdrop.dawn_bank.brief: The waking riverbank at first light after the storm: the same bank as the night painting, washed in pale gold and rose, mist lifting off the river.
story.backdrop.dawn_bank.notes: in the game the placeholder is today's DAWN_SHADER grade over S01 (mouth_escape.gd, lane S), so the screen is unchanged until art installs; waking_bank.gd dawn_image() hands mouth_escape the installed file; dawn_placeholder is that grade worked on the CPU and stepped to 48 colours, for the reference render; opaque

ui.frame9.banner.brief: The dungeon's place-name banner: a dark moss band whose top and bottom feather out in a pixel dither, a lit step under the top and a shade over the bottom, and no rule across it (pass 3 D5), tiling across the screen.
ui.frame9.banner.notes: Claude's finished frame (tools/ui/build_frames.py --slots), saved at 3x like the other frames; UI.banner draws it at 0.78 times the banner's fade across banner_rect() (1152x100 at most); on its placeholder UI.banner draws today's flat band

ui.frame9.bar_fill.brief: A gauge's fill: a white top row over a light grey one, one pixel wide at 3x, tinted by the gauge's colour at runtime.
ui.frame9.bar_fill.notes: Claude's finished frame; UI.bar tints it by the gauge colour times 1.25, so the grey row shows the colour itself and the top row a lit step

ui.frame9.bar_well.brief: A gauge's well: brass end caps, an ink lip along the top, and the dark slot the fill sits in.
ui.frame9.bar_well.notes: Claude's finished frame (tools/ui/build_frames.py --slots); UI.bar draws it on gauges at least 18x9, the fill 3 px in from each end and under the lip; smaller gauges (the 3 px growth slivers) and the placeholder keep today's flat well

ui.frame9.focus_row.brief: The focused row in a list: flat moss inside a brass rim lit on its top and left, with a highlight inside the lit edges and a shade inside the others.
ui.frame9.focus_row.notes: Claude's finished frame (tools/ui/build_frames.py --slots); UI.focus_row draws it on rows at least 12x12 (dungeon.gd bag and teach rows; hub_town.gd job rows by cross-lane request); on its placeholder UI.focus_row draws today's flat fill and rim

ui.frame9.headshot.brief: The well behind a 48 px headshot: river-blue ground, a shadow inside its top and left, inside a brass rim lit on its top and left.
ui.frame9.headshot.notes: Claude's finished frame (tools/ui/build_frames.py --slots); rim inside the 48x48: UI.headshot_well draws the whole frame under the face (margins 6), UI.headshot_rim only its outer ring over the face (margins 3, no middle), brighter for the leader; dungeon.gd team panel, hub_town.gd faces by cross-lane request; on its placeholder both draw today's flat square and 1 px edge
